title: Chatterbox
author: IchorOfRuin
description:
Introducing Chatterbox - the desktop chat app that brings back the simplicity of text-based communication. With its simple, uncomplicated design and minimalist interface, Chatterbox is perfect for those who prefer a straightforward chatting experience on their desktop. Whether you're catching up with old friends, or making new ones, Chatterbox provides an efficient platform for all your conversations. Say goodbye to distractions and ads, and hello to meaningful connections with Chatterbox. Download now and rediscover the joy of text-based chatting on your desktop.
(Written for the 2024 Dialogue Jam!)
